Please act as an independent scientific Innovator for a bounded pre-relay
search about delayed association-specific credit in a multi-agent renewal
setting. I want a skeptical constructive analysis, not a code review and not a
catalogue of modules. Try to make the strongest admissible case for a host that
really needs association-aware source-to-waiter credit, while being equally
willing to show that no candidate survives.

The retained starting evidence has two parts. In the original two-agent B1
host, an ordered joiner-to-waiter effect and later-record update were
expressible, and intact credit modestly changed selectivity, but intact and
ordinary GAE had exactly equal fixed-token allocation and bounded utility at
all twelve roots. The registered binding corruption also changed a generic
type/cue relation, so it did not isolate physical waiter identity. A later
locally executed T3 prerequisite used exactly three persistent agents and a
balanced directed compatibility cycle. It established clean ordered-waiter
support: every joiner contrast and interaction was 0.8, identity marginals
cancelled, and severing the waiter transition collapsed the contrasts to zero.
Yet exact pair-aware GAE and the pair-Q oracle had gradient cosine essentially
one and identical noiseless allocation probabilities. The oracle's sampled
favorable-allocation probability advantage was only about 2.22e-5, while its
actual fixed-token allocation and normalized-utility gains were exactly zero
at every root; source-localized excess was about 0.000543. Treat that T3 result
as valid terminal science and only as a failure-mode constraint. It is not
remotely published at the commit below and must not be represented as if it
were.

The code is scientific reference for the old host and estimator semantics, not
an invitation to audit implementation quality.

The new search is prospectively limited to three causal topologies in this
fixed order. The first is overlapping many-to-one contention, where several
live source records recruit or defer eligible waiters whose delayed service
windows collide at a shared queue, port, or capacity token. The second is
serial two-hop complementarity, where a source changes one of several waiters
and that waiter's later action enables or blocks a second downstream hop, so
bounded utility depends on an ordered path rather than immediate compatibility.
The third is a censored substitution chain, where an original waiter may
persist, expire, or be replaced before later service and the full public
history records survival, substitution, and service. Each topology gets one
smallest symmetry-respecting finite construction only. A failed construction
cannot be tuned, replaced, or renamed, and the first full survivor ends the
search.

For each family, build the strongest canonical instance you can without
looking for favorable numerical settings: at least three persistent agents,
two eligible waiters in the same generic action-time stratum, a binary source
decision, at least two causally relevant later transitions, balanced identity
marginals, bounded external utility, and no reward paid from a direct identity
label. Trace the source action through the true waiter's physical state to the
scarce decision and utility. If the topology cannot uniquely determine a
minimal honest instance without outcome-driven tuning, say so and reject it as
underspecified.

The comparison must be genuinely difficult. Ordinary full-return GAE, a
competent generic pair-aware conditional-Q or Rao-Blackwellized estimator, and
the association-aware candidate receive the same action-time history, raw
trajectories, downstream observations, model capacity, behavior data, policy
class, trust map, update count, evaluator, and useful-work budget. If the
candidate consumes an event key, edge locator, decomposition, sufficient
statistic, model prediction, or causal observation, the generic estimator gets
the same object and may condition on it. A weaker critic, hidden compatibility
bit, privileged counterfactual, richer candidate representation, extra update,
or free metadata processing invalidates the family.

Analyze the finite history/action/tape distribution exactly rather than
proposing sampled training. For each admissible family, derive or tightly
characterize the population updates and the common-trust post-update scarce
decisions. Association must not merely rescale the generic update: after the
same preconditioner, its component orthogonal to the generic-Q update must be
at least 10 percent of its norm and must change at least one predeclared scarce
decision. Against both GAE and the generic estimator it must gain at least 0.10
of the full favorable-allocation span and at least 0.10 normalized bounded
utility, with a strictly positive exact lower bound across all balanced
symmetry panels. In a matched intervention that severs the physical waiter
path while preserving histories, contexts, outcomes, work, and evaluator, the
native association-minus-generic utility gap must exceed the severed gap by at
least 0.05 with a strictly positive exact lower bound. Probability movement
without actual decisions, magnitude-only movement removed by the trust map, or
an advantage reproduced by the generic estimator or severed panel is a stop.

Please examine the families in the stated order and report whether the first
full survivor exists. For every rejection, identify the earliest failed gate
and give the concrete equality, counterexample, or information/work defect
that causes it. In particular, test whether exact conditional-Q sufficiency or
Rao-Blackwellization necessarily absorbs the proposed association signal, but
do not assume that conclusion in advance; look hard for multi-step interference,
curvature, censoring, or complementarity that could yield a real noncollinear
and source-localized scarce-decision advantage under equal information and
work. If one family survives analytically, specify the smallest remaining
answer-changing exact observation and the facts that must be frozen before any
execution. If none survives, state the narrowest no-survivor claim, the
strongest countercase, any genuinely different future reentry idea, and the
common failure risk this reveals for finite-host credit research. Do not infer
relay value, general impossibility, learned-critic behavior, multi-update
superiority, variable-population value, transfer, UAV relevance, safety, or
deployment from this bounded search.
